feature_contract.goal: Translate game-authored D3D9 SM3 VS/PS M4x4/M4x3/M3x4/M3x3/M3x2 matrix operations with actual D3D9 constant-register rows, physical TEMP liveness and exact GPU HLSL row dots in live D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed while preserving original game input, FFB and D3D9 rendering fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All five SM3 matrix forms decode from actual game VS/PS bytecode and reach native D3D11 vertex/pixel shader HLSL with matching row count and vector width, bounded constants and GPU draw bindings.
Unwritten TEMP components, nonexistent destination lanes, missing/misdeclared matrix constant rows and unsupported dimensions reject without altering original D3D9/DX9Ex Draw, gamepad or FFB.
DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Win32 Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector all complete SUCCESS on the same validation-bearing code SHA; runtime requires a separate Quest3/VDXR real game session.

integration_path: Decode D3D9 game-created SM3 VS/PS M4x4/M4x3/M3x4/M3x3/M3x2 and actual physical source vector widths
Bind real D3D9 constant rows, enforce TEMP read masks, emit native DX11 matrix dot HLSL and shader objects
Use existing live D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed and original D3D9/FFB fallback; whole game frame/hardware acceptance separate

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Source-generated five matrix ops with live D3D9 c rows, native HLSL rows, native VS/PS binding; Win32 Build and all five Actions succeed on one exact SHA.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Matrix dimensions, missing constant rows, unwritten TEMP components and out-of-range destination masks reject; CI static graph exact V7 provenance check preserved.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 SM3 game Draw/DrawIndexed interception -> shader bytecode operand decoder -> native GPU HLSL materialization -> native shader/object and live game draw, original D3D9 fall-back retained.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Native game Draw count and full menu/car/race output UNTESTED; exact-SHA source/build success is not real game evidence.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native full-frame opt-in; D3D9Ex game render/input/FFB authoritative fallback; DXVK frozen.
